# Discord Flow

Jump to Discord channels

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/octocat/discord-flow)](https://github.com/octocat/discord-flow/releases/latest) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/octocat/discord-flow)](https://github.com/octocat/discord-flow/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Installation

In [Flow Launcher](https://www.flowlauncher.com/), type:

```text
pm install Discord Flow
```

## Usage

Type `dc` followed by a channel name.
